propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE at src/rebar/llm/completion.py:48-65 directs FAIL callers to add ticket-comment evidence but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external (non-repository) evidence.

Untagged external criteria are deliberately classified as codebase-verifiable per ADR 0043; an operator following the incomplete remediation guidance received a second FAIL on an untagged criterion, wasting 240 verifier requests.

Remediation guidance must affirmatively distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from operator-attested external evidence, stating the exact tag prerequisite and the untagged-external fallback limitation.

The strengthened interface test test_fail_verdict_carries_remediation_guidance requires the canonical codebase-verifiable kind, the exact [operator-attested] tag, and assertion that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comment alone.
